notes: Baseline AMD64 System V/Darwin caller-saved leaf ABI; zero iterations returns seed without data access.
All state arithmetic wraps modulo 2^64; actual loop work feeds the returned state.
The shift/OR pair is a 64-bit rotate right by 13; both variants XOR the same salt.

MCA contains the actual straight-line body only, including result moves; entry, constant setup, loop control and return are excluded. Constants and mask are assumed ready; body flags are discarded by loop control. No model fidelity or performance win is claimed.
